title: Recurrence Garden
text: Time Grass and Time Flowers grow in nearly equal measure without trees, beside scattered shallow ponds of Decayed Timeflow. Every five minutes the garden cycles: grass and flowers exchange places, and temporal silt alternates between ordinary and sedimented states. Silt touching timeflow also passes through a rotted stage.

Mature crops return to their first growth stage; immature crops stay as they are. Crystal clusters within the garden advance one stage per cycle and restart as small buds after maturity. Empty faces of budding blocks within the garden begin growing too.
If you wear a Crystal Grid while the cycle turns, its selected spell advances to the next slot, including empty slots.
